svg.title: Supplementary angles give equal triangle areas but different sector areas
svg.desc: Two sectors share radius three centimetres. Their angles are pi over four and three pi over four. The radius lines are teal, arcs solid blue, and chords dashed orange. The orange triangles each have area nine square root two over four square centimetres. The sector areas are nine pi over eight and twenty-seven pi over eight; subtract the common triangle area for each pale blue minor segment. Both angles are less than pi.
